title: Price-data policy (decided before any backtest is published)
status: Adopted as the project default on 2026-11-16. No price source is connected. The owner may amend this policy at any time; amendments are logged in COORDINATION.md.
rules: R1. No backtest, ROI, CLV or originated-line result is published unless it is computed from price records that carry an open timestamp, a close timestamp, a named source, and a terms/licence check recorded in data/sources.json.
R2. Price records are append-only. A correction is a new row that cites the reason; the old row is kept.
R3. A missing closing line is recorded as missing. It is never filled from another book, a model, or an estimate.

R4. No automated collection from NFL pages or sportsbook pages is configured. NFL.com Terms s.1.3 prohibit systematic retrieval, or compiling a database from the Services, without express prior written consent (S29).
R5. The public site shows only aggregates derived from price records. Row-level prices are not published unless a licence permits redistribution.
R6. A pre-registration commit (data/prereg.json) must exist before any evaluation window opens. Results computed before registration are labelled exploratory and are barred from the leaderboard.
blocks: G-13 compliance and source licensing (partially satisfied)
Backtest corpus (136-game log has no prices)
clears_when: A named price source with a recorded licence or written permission, and at least one open/close pair stored under R1.
